Gate state on Tuesday, August 25, 2026: item-scoped `reflow` and `precheck` are clean on both owned pairs; `proof-contract --strict` is clean (`49/49`); `coverage-checklist`, `content-policy`, `validate-plan`, and page `prosecheck` are clean; `fwdcheck` and `extcheck` are clean; `citecheck` has warnings only. The only red result is `depcheck`, and the blocker recorded in the notes is a pre-existing repo-wide page cycle outside batch 5: `isolated-singularities-and-laurent-series-examples -> isolated-singularities-and-laurent-series -> isolated-singularities-and-laurent-series-examples`.

Authoring deltas from the scaffold were limited to honest dependency additions and one scoping clarification. The actual dependency changes are recorded in the notes for six items: `cor-integer-partitions-have-euler-product`, `lem-cyclic-rotation-fixed-tuples-are-periodic`, `cor-plane-trees-satisfy-t-equals-z-over-one-minus-t`, `cor-binary-trees-satisfy-b-equals-one-plus-z-b-squared`, `thm-worpitzky-identity`, and `cor-eulerian-polynomial-exponential-generating-function`. The three false statements were authored with `provenance.statement: ai-altered` rather than `ai-generated`, and `fs-multiset-product-exists-for-every-coefficient-sequence` was scoped to the omitted size-zero/local-finiteness hypothesis. Confidence is moderate on the mathematics and high on the batch-local mechanical state; no judge or step-6 audit tooling was run.
